_comment: Allow-list registry of top-level shared-content dirs that must appear in infra_dirs of every host manifest in provision/hosts/. Enforced by scripts/lint-skills-manifest.mjs meta-rule (WI-137). Adding a new entry requires adding the dir to every provision/hosts/<host>.json's infra_dirs in the same change.
_exception_note: rules/ is excluded from infra_dirs by design — it has its own dedicated install path in setup (handled separately from the infra_dirs symlink loop).
